entries.what: First part: 4 copper ingots around a cobblestone. Used in almost every Age 0 item.
Age 0 battery. Wind it at a [[winding_crank]], then right-click a robot with it.
Age 0 moving part for the first robots and machines.
Age 0 body for Stumpy and Sprout.
Plate for Age 1 recipes. [[tinkers_hammer]] + 2 ingots by hand, or 1 ingot in the [[metal_press]]. Other mods' plates work too.
Age 1 part: 8 copper around an iron ingot. Goes into motors, coils and Tesla Coils.
Age 1 casing. The base of Wired machines.
Age 1 circuit (needs gold). Used in the Grinder, Electric Furnace and most Wired machines.
Age 1 moving part. Powers drills, drones and machines.
Batteries for robots, machines and suits. A cell in your inventory recharges the FE tool in your hand.
use: Right-click a robot or machine to swap it into the battery slot.

entries.what: Age 2 casing: iron casings, obsidian and a diamond.
Age 2 circuit (needs a diamond).
Age 2 moving part.
Age 3 casing. Needs a Magma Core.
Age 3 circuit (needs blaze rods and netherite).
Age 3 moving part. Also the speed boost of the Mob Replicator (x2).
Age 4 casing. Needs an Antigrav Core.
Age 4 circuit (needs a nether star).
Opens Age 2. Drops from the Scrap Colossus. In an Exo chestplate: Overclock (Overclock key, default O).
Opens Age 3. Drops from the Forge Tyrant. Survey Rig core slot: ancient debris and resonite. Exo chestplate: fire immunity.
Opens Age 4. Exo chestplate: no fall damage, cheaper flight.
Overworld ore deep underground. Drops Raw Thorium.
Nether ore. Drops Pyrolite Shards and some experience.
Rare ore on the outer End islands. Drops Resonite Crystals.
Raw thorium from the ore. Smelt it, or grind it for more.
Thorium: for ferrothorium, fuel pellets and Thermocouples.
Pyrolite from the Nether: goes into pyrosteel and Enriched Fuel.
Resonite from the End: goes into resonant alloy and Fusion Fuel.
Age 2 alloy: iron + thorium in the [[alloy_smelter_mk1]].
Age 3 alloy: ferrothorium + pyrolite + blaze powder.
Age 4 alloy: pyrosteel + resonite + ender pearl.
Ground coal or charcoal. For fuel pellets, fuel rods and coils.
Age 2 part, made only in the Assembler. For the RTG and Mk2 machines.
Age 3 part, made only in the Assembler. For Mk3 machines, Exo Mk3 and fusion parts.
Age 4 part, made only in the Assembler. For Mk4 machines and Exo Mk4.
Fission fuel. The thorium pellet also runs the [[rtg]].
Spent fuel. The Centrifuge turns it back into thorium and graphite, sometimes a Radiant Isotope.
Centrifuge result from spent fuel (20%). Goes into Fusion Fuel.
Fusion Reactor fuel: 200,000 FE/t for 6,000 ticks (5 minutes).
Controller of the Mob Replicator: insert a full Essence Vial and power it to get that mob's loot.
Shell blocks of the Mob Replicator. At least one glass.
Takes samples from a hostile mob. 8 samples fill it.
use: Right-click a mob (2 damage, 3 s cooldown).

entries.what: Moves items between chests and machines, instantly. Arms are Insert by default.
use: Place pipes from the source to the target.
Sneak-right-click the arm at the source with an empty hand: Extract.
Right-click an arm: mode, a 9-slot filter (whitelist or blacklist) and the Extract order (Round robin or Closest first) and the Insert priority (Highest to Lowest).
Mk2 to Mk4: 8 pipes of the tier below around an Electric Motor, Servo Actuator or Plasma Actuator.
entries.image: shots/17_item_pipes.jpg|Item Pipes from a chest through a Grinder and an Electric Furnace into a chest

entries.what: A big sorted chest with search and a crafting grid.
use: With JEI: the J button next to the search box syncs it with JEI's search (on by default).
Add Storage Expansions for more room.
Takes empty shulker boxes and bundles only.

entries.what: More slots for the Storage Terminal (3 expansion slots).
Teleport pad. Name it, stand on it and right-click to travel to any of your pads (or public ones).
use: Stand on it, right-click, pick a destination.

entries.what: Lets a Warp Pad jump between dimensions.
Hold right-click 3 s to go home to its bound pad. Getting hit cancels.
use: Sneak-right-click a Warp Pad to bind it.

entries.what: Stores up to 10 Warp Pads in a list and works across dimensions.
use: Right-click: pick a pad from the list.

entries.what: Portal Projector: throws a floating portal to its linked projector, in any dimension.
Links two Portal Projectors: sneak-right-click A, then B.
Builds halls from matter and takes them down again. Pick plots on a grid and press Build.
use: Pick plots in the GUI, then Build.
A casing in the style slot opens higher styles.
Demolish (click twice) clears every built plot: the table's own building blocks back as matter, the rest into a chest touching the table.

rows: 1 block per tick, 5 FE each, 75% matter back

entries.image: shots/25_architect_build.jpg|Halls in four styles built around an Architect Table

entries.what: A building style of the Architect Table (Age 0). Also craftable by hand, 8 at a time.
A building style of the Architect Table (Age 1). Also craftable by hand, 8 at a time.
A building style of the Architect Table (Age 2). Also craftable by hand, 8 at a time.
A building style of the Architect Table (Age 4). Also craftable by hand, 8 at a time.
The in-game guide: your next steps and every recipe. New players get one.
Wakes the Scrap Colossus boss. Found in Rusted Foundries, or craft your own.
Summons the Scrap Colossus at an altar. It drops the [[servo_core]].
Wakes the Forge Tyrant boss. Found in Cinder Forges in the Nether, or craft your own.
entries.image: shots/27_forge_tyrant.jpg|The Forge Tyrant venting next to its Forge Altar

entries.what: Summons the Forge Tyrant at a Forge Altar. It drops the [[magma_core]].
Machines work faster and use more FE per action. Each card is one step: x2, x3, x4, x6, x8, x11, x15, x20.
Machines use 15% less FE per action per card, never below 40%. Combustion Generator: 10% less fuel per card.
Bigger work area or range: robots +2 radius, Excavator +10 wide, Wireless Charger +4 blocks, Electric Furnace +1 item per lane per card.
Fortune I-III on mined blocks, more output in the Grinder and Alloy Smelter, +50% experience in the Electric Furnace, Looting in the Replicator. Not with Silk Touch.
Mined blocks drop themselves. Single card. Not together with Fortune.
Farm bots: +50% crop and sapling growth per card.
Deletes junk or outputs that don't fit. Single card.
Architect Table: buildings one block taller per card.
Storage Terminal keeps its items when picked up. Right-click the terminal with it; it stays in.
